If set to true, applies the mask 0x0fffffff and disables HARQ feedback for all except the first four HARQs.
If set to a string, it must be a 32-bit bitmap (0x… or 0b…) of the HARQ processes to disable.

enable_ul_static_compr_hdr.description: Uplink static compression header enabled flag

ignore_ecpri_payload_size.description: Ignore eCPRI payload size field value

ignore_ecpri_seq_id.description: Ignore eCPRI sequence id field value

ignore_prach_start_symbol.description: Ignore the start symbol field in the PRACH U-Plane packets

network_interface.description: Network interface name for raw sockets. PCIe (or other bus) port identifier when using DPDK

t1a_max_cp_dl.description: T1a maximum value for downlink Control-Plane

t1a_max_cp_ul.description: T1a maximum value for uplink Control-Plane

t1a_min_cp_dl.description: T1a minimum value for downlink Control-Plane

t1a_min_cp_ul.description: T1a minimum value for uplink Control-Plane

vlan_pcp_cp.description: C-Plane VLAN PCP (requires --vlan_tag_cp to be set as well)

vlan_pcp_up.description: U-Plane VLAN PCP (requires --vlan_tag_up to be set as well)

warn_unreceived_ru_frames.description: Warn of unreceived Radio Unit frames

ceiling.description: Clipping ceiling referenced to full scale

tx_gain_backoff.description: Gain back-off to accommodate the signal PAPR in decibels

dl_freq_Hz.description: Downlink frequency in Hz. If present, it overrides the one derived by DL ARFCN and NR Band.

low_phy_dl_throttling.description:
System time-based throttling.
Determines a minimum baseband processor period time between downlink packets. It is expressed as a 
fraction of the time equivalent to the number of samples in the baseband buffer. Set to 0.9 to ensure 
that the downlink packets are processed with a minimum period of 90% of the buffer duration.
Set to zero to disable this feature.

power_ramping_time_us.description:
Specifies the power ramping time in microseconds, it proactively initiates the transmission and 
mitigates transient effects.

tx_mode.description:
Selects a radio transmission mode. Discontinuous modes are not supported by all radios.
  continuous:    the TX chain is always active.
  discontinuous: the transmitter stops when there is no data to transmit.
  same-port:     the radio transmits and receives from the same antenna port.

time_alignment_calibration.description:
Rx to Tx radio time alignment calibration in samples.
Positive values reduce the RF transmission delay with respect
to the RF reception, while negative values increase it (a signed integer or the sentinel "auto" (skip calibration))

ul_freq_Hz.description: Uplink frequency in Hz. If present, it overrides the one derived by UL ARFCN and NR Band.

max_sn_per_status.description: RLC AM RX status SN limit

max_window.description: Non-standard parameter that limits the tx window size. Can be used for limiting memory usage with large windows. 0 means no limits other than the SN size (i.e. 2^[sn_size-1]).

queue-bytes.description: RLC AM TX SDU queue size in bytes

queue-size.description: RLC AM TX SDU queue size in PDUs

test_ue.description: automatically created UE for testing purposes

attach_detach_duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds of active traffic after all UEs are established before they are released and recreated. When set, UEs cycle indefinitely through attach, traffic, and detach. Unset disables cycling.

attach_detach_guard_duration_ms.description: Guard period duration in milliseconds between a release cycle and the next creation cycle.

auto_ack_indication_delay.description: Delay before the UL and DL HARQs are automatically ACKed. This feature should only be used if the UL PHY is not operational

cqi.description: Channel Quality Information (CQI) to be forwarded to test UE.

i_1_1.description: Precoder Matrix codebook index "i_1_1" to be forwarded to test UE, in the case of more than 2 antennas.

i_1_3.description: Precoder Matrix codebook index "i_1_3" to be forwarded to test UE, in the case of more than 2 antennas.

i_2.description: Precoder Matrix codebook index "i_2" to be forwarded to test UE, in the case of more than 2 antennas.

nof_ues.description: Number of test UE(s) to create.

pmi.description: Precoder Matrix Indicator (PMI) to be forwarded to test UE.

ri.description: Rank Indicator (RI) to be forwarded to test UE.

ue_creation_stagger_slots.description: Number of slots between consecutive test mode UE creations

filename.description: Set to a valid file path to enable tracing and write the trace to the file

phy_enable.description: Enable tracing for physical layer executors

max_tracing_events_per_file.description: Maximum number of events per file. Set to zero for no limit

nof_tracing_events_after_severe.description: Number of events to write prior to a severe event. Set to zero for writing all events
